basic_info.description: Nestled within the prestigious Fillmore Heritage, this exquisite corner unit offers the pinnacle of city living in the heart of San Francisco's iconic Fillmore Jazz District. With sweeping, views of the city including the majestic City Hall this professionally managed residence seamlessly blends modern sophistication with amenities. The expansive living area is bathed in natural light, creating a serene and airy atmosphere. An open kitchen features stainless steel appliances, gas range, and bar area. In-unit stackable washer and dryer. Residents indulge in amenities, including a lobby attendant, a beautifully landscaped courtyard with a dog run, and spaces for entertaining. The property also offers a garage parking, a private storage locker, and proximity to Michelin-starred dining such as State Bird Provisions and Avery. Prime location near Japantown, Pacific Heights, and Hayes Valley with easy access to public transportation.
